messages:
Maya: Quick sync 10min: follow-ups from last night's KV OOM postmortem. We need firm owners and a cadence for verification.
Chris: Sounds good. Root cause summary: slow eviction + slab fragmentation causing residency to drift on long-lived shards. Pattern shows after ~36h of warm traffic.
Oliver: I exported an alloc flame and a slab map; suspicious hotspots in the batch serializer path. Upload: https://redwood-internal/archives/kv/alloc-flame-415123.
Nikhil: Suggestion: short-circuit unaccessed keys after 24h + conservative resident_capping on hot shards to avoid growth.
Priya: Can we list action items and owners here so I can add them to the tracker? I'll own the tracker PR and weekly checks.
Maya: Proposed actions: 
1) Canary resident cap (owner: Chris, ETA: 36h)
2) Profiling sweep: 8 hosts, jemalloc + tcmalloc snapshots (owner: Oliver, ETA: 72h)
3) Slab reclaim experiment: enable reclaim aggressive flag + measure p99 (owner: Nikhil, ETA: 5d)
4) Eviction score refactor: add access-age term and cap growth (owner: Maya, ETA: 2w)
5) Postmortem artifacts retention: keep heap dumps 21 days (owner: Priya, ETA: 24h)
Chris: I'll spin up a canary config in staging:
```yaml
kv:
  resident_cap_pct: 0.8
  eviction_policy: lru_with_age
  eviction_batch_ms: 30
```
I'll include a rollback and a synthetic traffic run for 6h.
Oliver: For profiling, I'll add a collection job `ops/collect_kv_profiles.sh` that captures: jemalloc stats, /proc/smaps, and a brief pprof CPU sample. I'll attach to tracker once done.
Nikhil: On slab reclaim: local bench shows reclaim reduces resident by ~18% but p99 latency up by ~10ms on tiny requests. I'll gate by latency SLO and do a region-limited canary.
Priya: Tracker plan: PR will create action rows, map to PM-2026-KV-RESIDENCY, and set weekly recurring reminders on Mon 11am for 4 weeks. I'll also add acceptance criteria for each item.
Maya: Acceptance criteria examples: resident_cap canary: "no >2x increase in evictions compared to baseline; p99 latency delta <5%".
Chris: Risk note: resident cap could increase eviction churn. We'll add transient fallback to model-route-throttle for 10m windows.
Oliver: Also adding a dashboard tile: "shard_residency:trend by model_size" and an alert: threshold sustain > 6h.
Maya: PostmortemBot: linked postmortem PM-2026-KV-RESIDENCY. Ensure every action references it.
PostmortemBot: auto-note: PM-2026-KV-RESIDENCY linked to thread 4151234567.
Priya: Signed up: I will open tracker PR in 1h.
Chris: Signed 1) will create staging canary in 6h, 2) rollback plan in same PR.
Oliver: Signed 1) profiling sweep started, will post artifacts to tracker.
Nikhil: Signed 1) slab reclaim A/B scheduled tomorrow, will post results.
Maya: Thanks. If any ETA slips, ping here. I'll consolidate action roster and follow up with infra to reserve canary hosts. :thumbsup: 
Priya: Adding smoke-test checklist to tracker: baseline mem, 6h simulated traffic, validate eviction counts, p50/p95/p99 latencies, and check for GC spikes.
Maya: We'll reconvene async next Mon; escalate mid-week if any alert fires. End of thread.
